existingReportSummary.executiveSummaryMd: RelatedPerson has one clear local hard validation risk (`communication.language` required binding), one high R6-to-R4 round-trip risk (`role` added), and a significant semantic split of `relationship` into personal relationship versus functional role. Confidence is high for StructureDefinition deltas and medium for exact terminology-code impact without expansions.
existingReportSummary.migrationThemesMd: Migration should first validate all `RelatedPerson.communication.language` values against BCP-47 and replace text-only/local language concepts with `urn:ietf:bcp:47` codings where possible. Second, classify each R4 `relationship` coding: personal relationships remain on `relationship`; functional contacts such as employer, emergency contact, interpreter, guarantor, or power of attorney should move to R6 `role`. Third, R6-to-R4 transforms need an extension or lossy policy for `role` because R4 has no native element.
existingReportSummary.confidenceSummaryMd: Confidence is high that the local element set, cardinalities, types, reference targets, bindings, and flags were compared because both local StructureDefinitions and package index entries were inspected. Confidence is lower for exact code-level relationship migration because the R6 personal relationship value set is referenced from terminology.hl7.org but was not present as a local ValueSet to expand.
